summary: Completed comprehensive testing of iteration 18: Uber Driver-style 4-tab bottom navigation dashboard. All features verified working correctly. Bottom tab bar with 4 tabs (Accueil, Revenus, Messages, Menu), status toggle, active ride panel with action buttons, vehicle modal, and all menu sections functioning as expected.

Tab bar uses data-testid attributes for all tabs: 'tab-home', 'tab-revenus', 'tab-inbox', 'tab-menu'
Status title uses data-testid='driver-status-title' for easy testing
Active ride panel shows passenger info with action buttons (arrived, start, complete)
Vehicle modal has VOITURE/MOTO selector with data-testid='modal-vehicle-car-btn' and 'modal-vehicle-moto-btn'
Revenus tab shows wallet balance, stats grid, and transaction history
Menu tab shows profile card, quick actions, and organized sections (Gérer, Argent, Ressources)
Logout button shows user email for confirmation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 tested the new Uber Driver-style 4-tab bottom navigation dashboard. All tabs working: Accueil (home with map, status toggle, pending/active rides), Revenus (wallet balance, stats, transactions), Messages (notifications, ride history), Menu (profile, quick actions, sections). Vehicle modal opens from Menu > Véhicules with VOITURE/MOTO selector. Active ride flow: Accept → Arrivé → Démarrer → Terminer. Earnings update correctly after ride completion (15% platform commission deducted).
